guide.summary: Chinese picks the verb and the word order by whether the thing is new or already known. New, indefinite thing: start with the place and put the thing last (Place + 有 / V着 / V了 + a thing). Known, definite thing: put it first and locate it with 在. 是 after a place identifies what occupies it. A place is a noun plus a location word (桌子上), never an English-style preposition phrase.

subs.label: Place + 有 + a new thing
subs.focus: Cue is 'there is/are' + indefinite noun (一本书, 很多人): force 有 (not 在/是) and place-first order. Classic errors: indefinite noun first (一本书在桌子上), 在 as the verb after the place. Never hinge an item on whether 在 may precede the place (variable).

subs.label: Known thing + 在 + place
subs.focus: Cue locates a clearly definite thing (我的, 那本, a name, 'the bank') or asks 在哪儿: force 在 and thing-first order. Classic errors: place + 有 + definite thing (桌子上有我的手机 for 'my phone is on the table'), dropping 在.

subs.label: Place + 是 + what is there
subs.focus: Force 是 against 有/在 when the sentence names what occupies a known spot. 有 must be impossible: use a definite or named occupant (我旁边是小王), 都是/全是, or 是什么地方/是谁. Classic error: 在 after the place (学校对面在银行).

subs.label: When 上 / 里 is needed
subs.focus: Decide if 上/里 must follow the noun: objects need one (在桌子上, 在包里), cities and countries never take 里 (在北京), 上 for surfaces, vehicles, 墙, 黑板. Classic errors: 在桌子, 在冰箱, 在北京里. Do not test 里 after 学校, 公司, 家, 图书馆, 医院 (optional).

subs.label: Noun first, location word after
subs.focus: Force reference noun + location word (学校旁边, 椅子下面, 我后面) and the right word for the cue (旁边 前面 后面 中间 对面 附近 外面 下面). Classic errors: English order (旁边学校, 在前面我), 的 after 上/里 (桌子的上). Do not test optional 的 (学校的旁边 is fine).

subs.label: Place + V着 + a thing
subs.focus: Force Place + V着 + number-measure + noun (门口站着一个人) and 着 over 了/在/过. Classic errors: indefinite noun first (一个人站着在门口), 着 misplaced or missing. Verbs: 站 坐 躺 住 放 挂 写 画 贴 停 摆. Affirmative items only.

subs.label: Place / time + V了 + a new arrival
subs.focus: Force the newcomer after the verb: Place/time + 来/走/搬来/搬走/出现 + 了 + number-measure + noun (我们班来了一个新同学), against the expected definite one before the verb (客人来了). Classic error: place last as in English (一个新同学来了我们班).

subs.label: 没有 and 不在
subs.focus: Force 没有 for 'there is no X' and 不在 for 'X is not there'. Classic errors: 不有, number-measure after 没有 in a plain negative (桌子上没有一本书), negating the wrong verb (他没有家 for 'not at home'). Never offer 没在 as a distractor: it overlaps with 不在.

rules.rule: To say 'there is / there are', start with the place and put the new thing after 有. The thing is indefinite: a number and measure word, 很多, 几, or a bare noun.

examples.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn shū
examples.en: There is a book on the table.

examples.py: xué xiào páng biān yǒu yī gè gōng yuán
examples.en: There is a park next to the school.

examples.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu hěn duō fàn guǎn
examples.en: There are a lot of restaurants near my home.

examples.py: zhè r fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu yín háng
examples.en: Is there a bank near here?

rules.note: The place normally stands at the start without 在. 在桌子上有一本书 is heard, but the bare place is the standard form. A definite noun after 有 is possible only when listing what a place contains (我家有爸爸、妈妈和我), not when saying where a known thing is.

rules.rule: To say where a known thing or person is, put it first and use 在 as the verb. 'The', 'my', 'that', a name or a pronoun in English means 在, not 有.

examples.py: nǐ de shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
examples.en: Your phone is on the table.

examples.py: xiǎo wáng zài jiào shì lǐ
examples.en: Xiao Wang is in the classroom.

examples.py: yín háng zài chāo shì duì miàn
examples.en: The bank is across from the supermarket.

examples.py: wǒ de shū zài nǎ r
examples.en: Where is my book?

rules.rule: Use Place + 是 when you are naming what occupies a spot rather than announcing that something exists there. The thing after 是 can be definite, and 都是 / 全是 means the place is full of it.

examples.py: xué xiào duì miàn shì yī jiā yín háng
examples.en: Across from the school is a bank.

examples.py: wǒ páng biān shì xiǎo wáng
examples.en: The person next to me is Xiao Wang.

examples.py: zhuō zi shàng dōu shì shū
examples.en: The table is covered in books.

examples.py: qián miàn shì shén me dì fang
examples.en: What is that place up ahead?

rules.note: With an indefinite noun both verbs are often possible: 学校对面有一家银行 says a bank exists there (perhaps among other things); 学校对面是一家银行 says the thing over there is a bank. Only 是 works when the occupant is definite or a named person.

rules.rule: An ordinary object is not a place by itself. Add 上 for a surface and 里 for an inside before it can follow 在 or start an existence sentence.

examples.py: niú nǎi zài bīng xiāng lǐ
examples.en: The milk is in the fridge.

examples.py: dì tú zài qiáng shàng
examples.en: The map is on the wall.

examples.py: bāo lǐ yǒu liǎng gè píng guǒ
examples.en: There are two apples in the bag.

examples.py: tā zài huǒ chē shàng kàn shū
examples.en: He is reading on the train.

rules.note: Chinese uses 上 where English says 'in' or 'on' for vehicles and flat things you read: 在飞机上, 在公共汽车上, 在黑板上, 在报纸上. A person is made into a place with 这儿 / 那儿: 你的书在我这儿.

rules.rule: City and country names are already places: never add 里 after them. Buildings and institutions (学校, 公司, 家, 图书馆, 医院) are places too, so 里 is optional with them.

examples.py: tā zài běi jīng gōng zuò
examples.en: He works in Beijing.

examples.py: wǒ jiě jie xiàn zài zài shàng hǎi
examples.en: My older sister is in Shanghai now.

examples.py: zhōng guó yǒu hěn duō dà chéng shì
examples.en: There are many big cities in China.

rules.note: 他在学校 and 他在学校里 are both correct; 里 only stresses 'inside the grounds'.

rules.rule: The location word comes after the noun it refers to, the reverse of English: 'next to the school' is 学校旁边. 上 and 里 attach directly with no 的.

examples.py: māo zài yǐ zi xià miàn
examples.en: The cat is under the chair.

examples.zh: 超市在银行和书店中间。
examples.py: chāo shì zài yín háng hé shū diàn zhōng jiān
examples.en: The supermarket is between the bank and the bookshop.

examples.py: xiǎo wáng zuò zài wǒ hòu miàn
examples.en: Xiao Wang sits behind me.

examples.py: jiào shì wài miàn yǒu hěn duō xué shēng
examples.en: There are a lot of students outside the classroom.

rules.note: Two-syllable location words may take 的 (学校的旁边), but it is usually left out. A location word can also stand alone as a place: 前面有一家咖啡店.

rules.rule: To say how something is sitting, standing, hanging or lying somewhere, replace 有 with a posture or placement verb plus 着. The order stays place first, new thing last.
rules.pattern: Place + Verb + 着 + number + measure + Noun

examples.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè rén
examples.en: There is someone standing at the door.

examples.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng dì tú
examples.en: There is a map hanging on the wall.

examples.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng bēi kā fēi
examples.en: There are two cups of coffee on the table.

rules.note: If the thing is definite it goes first and the pattern changes to Verb + 在: 那张地图挂在墙上.

rules.rule: When someone or something new turns up or leaves, the newcomer goes after the verb. A place or a time word opens the sentence, and the verb takes 了.
rules.pattern: Place / Time + Verb + 了 + number + measure + Noun

examples.zh: 我们班来了一个新同学。
examples.py: wǒ men bān lái le yī gè xīn tóng xué
examples.en: A new classmate has joined our class.

examples.py: zuó tiān lái le yī wèi kè rén
examples.en: A guest came yesterday.

examples.py: lóu shàng bān zǒu le yī jiā rén
examples.en: A family has moved out from upstairs.

rules.note: Position shows whether the person is expected: 客人来了 means the guests (the ones we were waiting for) have arrived; 来客人了 or 来了一位客人 means a guest has turned up. Only verbs of appearing and disappearing work here (来, 走, 搬来, 搬走, 开来, 出现).

rules.rule: 'There is no X' is Place + 没有 + bare noun. 有 is never negated with 不, and the noun loses its number and measure word.

examples.py: zhuō zi shàng méi yǒu shū
examples.en: There are no books on the table.

examples.py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu niú nǎi le
examples.en: There is no milk left in the fridge.

examples.py: zhè r fù jìn méi yǒu dì tiě zhàn
examples.en: There is no subway station near here.

rules.note: In speech 没有 is often shortened to 没 before the noun: 家里没人. To stress 'not even one', use 一 + measure + noun + 也没有: 桌子上一本书也没有.

rules.rule: 'X is not at the place' is 不在. Choose the negative by the verb the positive sentence would use: 有 becomes 没有, 在 becomes 不在.

examples.py: tā bù zài jiā
examples.en: He is not at home.

examples.py: nǐ de shǒu jī bù zài zhuō zi shàng
examples.en: Your phone is not on the table.

examples.zh: 李老师现在不在办公室。
examples.py: lǐ lǎo shī xiàn zài bù zài bàn gōng shì
examples.en: Teacher Li is not in the office right now.

rules.note: 不在 works for the past as well (他昨天不在家). 没在 is also heard for a past occasion (他昨天没在家), so the two overlap there; 不在 is the safe choice.

right.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn shū
right.en: There is a book on the table.

contrasts.why: A new, indefinite thing cannot open the sentence as the subject of 在. Start with the place and introduce the thing after 有.

right.py: nǐ de shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
right.en: Your phone is on the table.

contrasts.why: 你的手机 is a known thing whose location is the news, so it goes first with 在. 有 introduces something the listener has not heard about.

right.py: xué xiào duì miàn shì yín háng
right.en: Across from the school is the bank.

contrasts.why: 在 needs the thing before it and the place after it. When the place comes first, the verb is 是 (identifying) or 有 (existing).

right.py: niú nǎi zài bīng xiāng lǐ
right.en: The milk is in the fridge.

contrasts.why: 冰箱 is an object, not a place. It needs 里 before it can follow 在.

right.py: wǒ zài běi jīng gōng zuò

contrasts.why: English 'in' is already covered by 在. City and country names never take 里.

right.py: yín háng zài xué xiào páng biān
right.en: The bank is next to the school.

contrasts.why: The location word follows its reference noun: 学校旁边, not the English order 'next to the school'.

right.py: jiào shì lǐ méi yǒu rén
right.en: There is nobody in the classroom.

contrasts.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没. 不有 does not exist.

right.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè rén
right.en: There is someone standing at the door.

contrasts.why: An unknown person is introduced after the verb: place first, then 站着, then 一个人. 着 is not followed by 在 + place.

contrasts.wrong: 一个新同学来了我们班。

right.zh: 我们班来了一个新同学。
right.py: wǒ men bān lái le yī gè xīn tóng xué
right.en: A new classmate has joined our class.

contrasts.why: The place cannot trail after 来了 the way it does in English. The place opens the sentence and the newcomer follows the verb.

cheat: 'There is a ...'? Place first, then 有, then the thing.
'The / my / that ...' or a name? Thing first, then 在 + place.
Place first and you are naming what it is (or 都是)? Use 是, never 在.
Object after 在? Add 上 or 里. City or country? No 里.
Location word goes after the noun: 学校旁边, 桌子下面, 我后面.
New thing standing, hanging, lying, arriving? Place + V着 / V了 + 一 + measure + noun.
Positive has 有: 没有 + bare noun. Positive has 在: 不在.

items.q: 办公室里___三台电脑。
items.zh: 办公室里有三台电脑。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu sān tái diàn nǎo
items.en: There are three computers in the office.
items.why: New, counted things at a place: Place + 有 + number + measure + noun. 在 would need the computers first (电脑在办公室里), and 着 needs a posture or placement verb before it.

items.q: 我的杯子___桌子上。
items.zh: 我的杯子在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ de bēi zi zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: My cup is on the table.
items.why: 我的杯子 is a known thing, so it comes first and 在 says where it is. 有 introduces something new and 是 does not locate an object like this.

items.q: 医院旁边___一家药店。
items.zh: 医院旁边有一家药店。
items.py: yī yuàn páng biān yǒu yī jiā yào diàn
items.en: There is a pharmacy next to the hospital.
items.why: The place opens the sentence and an indefinite thing (一家药店) follows 有. 在 would need the pharmacy first, and 着 cannot attach to a bare place phrase.

items.q: 经理___办公室里。
items.zh: 经理在办公室里。
items.py: jīng lǐ zài bàn gōng shì lǐ
items.en: The manager is in the office.
items.why: A known person located somewhere takes 在: Person + 在 + Place. 有 and 是 cannot link a person to the room they are in.

items.q: 冰箱里___水果。
items.zh: 冰箱里没有水果。
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu shuǐ guǒ
items.en: There is no fruit in the fridge.
items.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没, so the positive 有 becomes 没有. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 is for a known thing that is not at a place.

items.q: 王经理___办公室。
items.zh: 王经理不在办公室。
items.py: wáng jīng lǐ bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: Manager Wang is not in the office.
items.why: The positive version is 王经理在办公室, so the negative is 不在. 没有 would say he has no office, and 不是 would say he is not the office.

items.q: 药在桌子___。
items.zh: 药在桌子上。
items.py: yào zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: The medicine is on the table.
items.why: A table is an object, not a place, so it needs 上 for its surface. Leaving it off (在桌子) is incomplete, and 里 would put the medicine inside the table.

items.q: 水在杯子___。
items.zh: 水在杯子里。
items.py: shuǐ zài bēi zi lǐ
items.en: The water is in the cup.
items.why: Liquid inside a container needs 里 after the noun. A bare 在杯子 is incomplete and 杯子上 would mean on the surface of the cup.

items.q: 他在北京___工作。
items.zh: 他在北京工作。
items.py: tā zài běi jīng gōng zuò
items.en: He works in Beijing.
items.why: City names are already places, so nothing follows 北京. Adding 里 or 上 is the classic English-prepositions mistake.

items.q: 药店在医院___。
items.zh: 药店在医院对面。
items.py: yào diàn zài yī yuàn duì miàn
items.en: The pharmacy is across from the hospital.
items.why: The cue says across from, which is 对面. 旁边 means right beside, and 中间 needs two things to be between.

items.q: 我们公司对面___那家医院。
items.zh: 我们公司对面是那家医院。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī duì miàn shì nà jiā yī yuàn
items.en: Across from our company is that hospital.
items.why: With the place first and a definite thing (那家医院) named after it, the verb is 是. 在 needs the thing before it and the place after it.

items.q: 我旁边___小王，他是新来的同事。
items.zh: 我旁边是小王，他是新来的同事。
items.py: wǒ páng biān shì xiǎo wáng, tā shì xīn lái de tóng shì
items.en: The person next to me is Xiao Wang, a new colleague.
items.why: Place first, then naming who is there: 是. 在 would put the place after the verb and cannot follow 我旁边.

items.q: 他的桌子上___是文件，一点空地方都没有。
items.zh: 他的桌子上都是文件，一点空地方都没有。
items.py: tā de zhuō zi shàng dōu shì wén jiàn, yī diǎn kòng dì fang dōu méi yǒu
items.en: His desk is covered in documents; there is no free space at all.
items.why: 都是 after a place means it is full of one kind of thing. 也 means also and 才 means only then, neither fits a desk covered in documents.

items.q: 墙上___一张公司地图。
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张公司地图。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng gōng sī dì tú
items.en: A map of the company is hanging on the wall.
items.why: Place + V着 + number + measure + noun describes how something is placed. 挂过 would mean it once hung there, and 在挂 is not this pattern.

items.q: 门口站___一个人。
items.zh: 门口站着一个人。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè rén
items.en: There is someone standing at the door.
items.why: 站着 describes the state of standing, with the new person after the verb. 过 means it happened before, and 站在 would need a place after it.

items.q: 医生的桌子上放___一台电脑和两本书。
items.zh: 医生的桌子上放着一台电脑和两本书。
items.py: yī shēng de zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī tái diàn nǎo hé liǎng běn shū
items.en: There is a computer and two books on the doctor's desk.
items.why: The desk is the place, so 放着 describes what lies there. 放在 and 放到 need the place after the verb, but the place is already at the start.

items.q: 昨天我们公司来___一位新同事。
items.zh: 昨天我们公司来了一位新同事。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ men gōng sī lái le yī wèi xīn tóng shì
items.en: A new colleague came to our company yesterday.
items.why: A newcomer after 来 takes 了: Place + 来了 + number + measure + noun. 着 describes a continuing state, not an arrival, and 在 does not belong after 来.

items.q: 我们部门___了一个新经理。
items.zh: 我们部门来了一个新经理。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén lái le yī gè xīn jīng lǐ
items.en: A new manager has joined our department.
items.why: 来 is the verb of arrival, so the new manager joined. 走 would say a manager left, and 站 is a posture verb that does not fit 了 here.

items.q: 上个月我们大楼里搬___了一家公司。
items.zh: 上个月我们大楼里搬来了一家公司。
items.py: shàng gè yuè wǒ men dà lóu lǐ bān lái le yī jiā gōng sī
items.en: A company moved into our building last month.
items.why: 搬来 means move in, with the new company after 了. 搬走 would mean one left, and 搬开 means move aside.

items.q: 我们公司附近___很多饭馆，午饭很方便。
items.zh: 我们公司附近有很多饭馆，午饭很方便。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī fù jìn yǒu hěn duō fàn guǎn, wǔ fàn hěn fāng biàn
items.en: There are a lot of restaurants near our company, so lunch is easy.
items.why: 很多饭馆 is indefinite, so the place comes first and 有 follows. 在 would need the restaurants first, and 着 needs a placement verb.

items.q: 我的包里___一瓶药和一些水。
items.zh: 我的包里有一瓶药和一些水。
items.py: wǒ de bāo lǐ yǒu yī píng yào hé yī xiē shuǐ
items.en: There is a bottle of medicine and some water in my bag.
items.why: Listing new things in a place: Place + 有 + things. 没有 contradicts the cue, and 着 needs a verb like 放 in front of it.

items.q: 会议室里___十几个人，大家都在等经理。
items.zh: 会议室里有十几个人，大家都在等经理。
items.py: huì yì shì lǐ yǒu shí jǐ gè rén, dà jiā dōu zài děng jīng lǐ
items.en: There are a dozen or so people in the meeting room, all waiting for the manager.
items.why: 十几个人 is an indefinite number of people, so Place + 有 + number + measure + noun. 在 would put the people first as the subject.

items.q: 你要的那份文件___我的电脑里。
items.zh: 你要的那份文件在我的电脑里。
items.py: nǐ yào de nà fèn wén jiàn zài wǒ de diàn nǎo lǐ
items.en: The file you want is on my computer.
items.why: 那份文件 is a specific, known file, so it comes first and 在 gives its location. 有 would present it as something new, and 是 does not locate it.

items.q: 请问，药店___哪儿？
items.zh: 请问，药店在哪儿？
items.py: qǐng wèn, yào diàn zài nǎ r
items.en: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy?
items.why: Asking where a known place is takes Thing + 在 + 哪儿. 有 cannot be followed by 哪儿 in this question, and 着 is not a verb here.

items.q: 今天上午李老师___办公室，你下午再来吧。
items.zh: 今天上午李老师不在办公室，你下午再来吧。
items.py: jīn tiān shàng wǔ lǐ lǎo shī bù zài bàn gōng shì, nǐ xià wǔ zài lái ba
items.en: Teacher Li is not in the office this morning, so come back this afternoon.
items.why: The positive is 李老师在办公室, so the negative is 不在. 没有 would say he has no office at all, which does not fit the follow-up clause.

items.q: 我的钱包里___钱，只有几张卡。
items.zh: 我的钱包里没有钱，只有几张卡。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo lǐ méi yǒu qián, zhǐ yǒu jǐ zhāng kǎ
items.en: There is no cash in my wallet, only a few cards.
items.why: The positive is 钱包里有钱, so the negative is 没有. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 is for a known thing missing from a place.

items.q: 你要的药___抽屉里，再找找别的地方吧。
items.zh: 你要的药不在抽屉里，再找找别的地方吧。
items.py: nǐ yào de yào bù zài chōu tì lǐ, zài zhǎo zhao bié de dì fang ba
items.en: The medicine you want is not in the drawer, so look somewhere else.
items.why: 你要的药 is a specific, known thing, so the positive uses 在 and the negative is 不在. 没有 cannot take 抽屉里 as its object here.

items.q: 那张照片挂在墙___。
items.zh: 那张照片挂在墙上。
items.py: nà zhāng zhào piàn guà zài qiáng shàng
items.en: That photo is hung on the wall.
items.why: A wall is a surface, so it takes 上. Without it 墙 is not yet a place, and 里 would mean inside the wall.

items.q: 你的药在我的包___。
items.zh: 你的药在我的包里。
items.py: nǐ de yào zài wǒ de bāo lǐ
items.en: Your medicine is in my bag.
items.why: Something inside a bag needs 里 after 包. 上 would put it on top of the bag, and a bare 在我的包 is incomplete.

items.q: 我姐姐在上海___当医生。
items.zh: 我姐姐在上海当医生。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie zài shàng hǎi dāng yī shēng
items.en: My older sister works as a doctor in Shanghai.
items.why: 上海 is a city, already a place, so no 里 or 上 follows it. Adding either is the English-preposition mistake.

items.q: 他在公司的电梯___遇到了经理。
items.zh: 他在公司的电梯里遇到了经理。
items.py: tā zài gōng sī de diàn tī lǐ yù dào le jīng lǐ
items.en: He ran into the manager in the company lift.
items.why: The lift is an enclosed space, so it needs 里 to become a place for 'in the lift'. 外 would put the meeting outside it, and the learner's tempting 上 is also heard, so it is not offered.

items.q: 药店在我们公司___，走路五分钟就到。
items.zh: 药店在我们公司旁边，走路五分钟就到。
items.py: yào diàn zài wǒ men gōng sī páng biān, zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
items.en: The pharmacy is right next to our company, five minutes on foot.
items.why: The cue says next to, which is 旁边. 对面 means across the way, and 中间 needs two reference points.

items.q: 小王坐在我___。
items.zh: 小王坐在我后面。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuò zài wǒ hòu miàn
items.en: Xiao Wang sits behind me.
items.why: The location word comes after the reference noun (我后面). Behind is 后面; 前面 means in front, and 对面 means opposite.

items.q: 我们的办公室在电梯和楼梯___，很容易找。
items.zh: 我们的办公室在电梯和楼梯中间，很容易找。
items.py: wǒ men de bàn gōng shì zài diàn tī hé lóu tī zhōng jiān, hěn róng yì zhǎo
items.en: Our office is between the lift and the stairs, so it is easy to find.
items.why: Between two things is 中间 after both nouns. 旁边 means beside one thing, and 里面 means inside.

items.q: 办公室的抽屉里___很多药，有感冒药，也有胃药。
items.zh: 办公室的抽屉里有很多药，有感冒药，也有胃药。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de chōu tì lǐ yǒu hěn duō yào, yǒu gǎn mào yào, yě yǒu wèi yào
items.en: There is a lot of medicine in the office drawer, both cold medicine and stomach medicine.
items.why: 很多药 is new and indefinite, so Place + 有 + noun. 在 would need the medicine first, and 着 needs a placement verb.

items.q: 你要找的王医生___三楼的办公室，不在一楼。
items.zh: 你要找的王医生在三楼的办公室，不在一楼。
items.py: nǐ yào zhǎo de wáng yī shēng zài sān lóu de bàn gōng shì, bù zài yī lóu
items.en: Dr Wang, whom you are looking for, is in the third-floor office, not on the first floor.
items.why: Dr Wang is a known person located by 在, which also matches the contrast with 不在一楼. 有 would introduce him as new, and 是 would equate him with an office.

items.q: 我们办公室的左边是会议室，右边___经理的办公室。
items.zh: 我们办公室的左边是会议室，右边是经理的办公室。
items.py: wǒ men bàn gōng shì de zuǒ biān shì huì yì shì, yòu biān shì jīng lǐ de bàn gōng shì
items.en: To the left of our office is the meeting room, to the right the manager's office.
items.why: Both halves name what occupies a spot, so 是 repeats. 在 would need the manager's office first and the place after.

items.q: 那支笔在他的口袋___。
items.zh: 那支笔在他的口袋里。
items.py: nà zhī bǐ zài tā de kǒu dài lǐ
items.en: That pen is in his pocket.
items.why: Inside a pocket needs 里 after 口袋. 上 would put the pen on the outside of the pocket, and 外 would put it outside the pocket altogether.

items.q: 医院___有一家很大的药店，买药很方便。
items.zh: 医院外面有一家很大的药店，买药很方便。
items.py: yī yuàn wài miàn yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de yào diàn, mǎi yào hěn fāng biàn
items.en: There is a big pharmacy outside the hospital, so buying medicine is easy.
items.why: The cue says outside, which is 外面 placed after 医院. 里面 means inside, and 后面 means behind.

items.q: 这个办公室里___空调。
items.zh: 这个办公室里没有空调。
items.py: zhè gè bàn gōng shì lǐ méi yǒu kōng tiáo
items.en: There is no air conditioner in this office.
items.why: The positive is 办公室里有空调, so the negative is 没有 with a bare noun. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 is for a known thing.

items.zh: 办公室里有一台打印机。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu yī tái dǎ yìn jī
items.en: There is a printer in the office.
items.why: Place first, then 有, then the new thing with its measure word. The printer cannot open the sentence.

items.zh: 我的药在包里。
items.py: wǒ de yào zài bāo lǐ
items.en: My medicine is in my bag.
items.why: A known thing (我的药) goes first and 在 links it to the place. 包里 has 里 because a bag is an object.

items.zh: 公司后面有一个停车场。
items.py: gōng sī hòu miàn yǒu yī gè tíng chē chǎng
items.en: There is a car park behind the company.
items.why: The location word follows the noun: 公司后面. That place opens the sentence, and 有 introduces the car park.

items.zh: 小王不在公司。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bù zài gōng sī
items.en: Xiao Wang is not at the company.
items.why: The positive is 小王在公司, so the negative is 不在. 公司 needs no 里 here.

items.zh: 办公室里没有人了。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ méi yǒu rén le
items.en: There is nobody in the office any more.
items.why: Place + 没有 + bare noun, and 了 at the end marks the change. The noun has no number or measure word.

items.zh: 门口站着一位医生。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī wèi yī shēng
items.en: A doctor is standing at the door.
items.why: Place first, then 站着, then the new person with a measure word. The doctor cannot come before the verb.

items.zh: 我们部门来了一个新同事。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén lái le yī gè xīn tóng shì
items.en: A new colleague has joined our department.
items.why: The place opens the sentence and the newcomer follows 来了. Ending with the department, as in English, is wrong.

items.zh: 你的眼镜在椅子下面。
items.py: nǐ de yǎn jìng zài yǐ zi xià miàn
items.en: Your glasses are under the chair.
items.why: A known thing goes first and 在 links it to the place. The location word 下面 follows 椅子.

items.zh: 银行旁边是我们公司。
items.py: yín háng páng biān shì wǒ men gōng sī
items.en: Next to the bank is our company.
items.why: 我们公司 is a definite occupant named after the place, so the verb is 是. 有 could not introduce it, and 在 would not follow the place.

items.zh: 昨天我们公司来了两位新同事。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ men gōng sī lái le liǎng wèi xīn tóng shì
items.en: Two new colleagues came to our company yesterday.
items.why: The time and place come first (either order), and the newcomers follow 来了. Putting the place last is the English order.

items.zh: 会议室里坐着十几个开会的人。
items.py: huì yì shì lǐ zuò zhe shí jǐ gè kāi huì de rén
items.en: A dozen or so people are sitting in the meeting room, in a meeting.
items.why: Place + V着 + number + measure + modified noun. The new people are described after the verb, not before it.

items.zh: 墙上挂着一张人体图。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng rén tǐ tú
items.en: A diagram of the human body hangs on the wall.
items.why: Place first, then 挂着, then the new thing with its measure word 张. 墙上 has 上 because a wall is a surface.

items.zh: 药店在银行和医院中间。
items.py: yào diàn zài yín háng hé yī yuàn zhōng jiān
items.en: The pharmacy is between the bank and the hospital.
items.why: 中间 follows the two reference nouns joined by 和. The two nouns may swap places, but 中间 cannot come before them.

items.zh: 经理站在我们前面。
items.py: jīng lǐ zhàn zài wǒ men qián miàn
items.en: The manager is standing in front of us.
items.why: The location word follows its noun: 我们前面, never 前面我们. 站在 puts the manager at that place.

items.zh: 我的手机不在桌子上，也不在包里。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù zài zhuō zi shàng, yě bù zài bāo lǐ
items.en: My phone is not on the table, and not in my bag either.
items.why: The phone is a known thing, so each part uses 不在 rather than 没有. 也不在 repeats the negative for the second place.

items.zh: 我们公司附近一家药店也没有。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī fù jìn yī jiā yào diàn yě méi yǒu
items.en: There is not a single pharmacy near our company.
items.why: 一 + measure + noun + 也没有 stresses that there is not even one. 也 goes directly before 没有.

items.zh: 桌子上有三杯咖啡。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu sān bēi kā fēi
items.en: There are three cups of coffee on the table.
items.why: Place first, 有, then the counted new thing. The coffee cannot come first because it is indefinite.

items.zh: 鼻子在眼睛下面。
items.py: bí zi zài yǎn jing xià miàn
items.en: The nose is below the eyes.
items.why: 鼻子 is a known thing, so 在 links it to the place 眼睛下面. The location word follows its noun.

items.zh: 医生站在病人旁边。
items.py: yī shēng zhàn zài bìng rén páng biān
items.en: The doctor is standing next to the patient.
items.why: 旁边 comes after 病人. 站在 gives the place after the verb, so the place phrase is not fronted.

items.zh: 他的脸上有一个小伤口。
items.py: tā de liǎn shàng yǒu yī gè xiǎo shāng kǒu
items.en: There is a small cut on his face.
items.why: Place first, then 有, then the new thing. The cut is indefinite, so it cannot open the sentence with 在.

items.zh: 医院里来了很多病人。
items.py: yī yuàn lǐ lái le hěn duō bìng rén
items.en: A lot of patients have come to the hospital.
items.why: The newcomers (很多病人) go after 来了 with the place first. 病人来了医院里 is the English order.

items.zh: 上个月我们部门走了两位老同事。
items.py: shàng gè yuè wǒ men bù mén zǒu le liǎng wèi lǎo tóng shì
items.en: Two long-serving colleagues left our department last month.
items.why: Departures use the same pattern: place and time first, 走了, then the people who left. The time word can swap with the place.

items.zh: 门口停着一辆救护车。
items.py: mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng jiù hù chē
items.en: An ambulance is parked at the entrance.
items.why: Place + 停着 + number + measure + noun. 辆 is the measure word for vehicles, and the ambulance follows the verb.

items.zh: 我们公司对面都是医院。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī duì miàn dōu shì yī yuàn
items.en: Across from our company it is all hospitals.
items.why: 都是 after a place says it is full of one kind of thing. 有 would not carry the meaning that nothing else is there.

items.zh: 你要的那份文件在经理的桌子上。
items.py: nǐ yào de nà fèn wén jiàn zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng
items.en: The file you want is on the manager's desk.
items.why: The definite file goes first, then 在, then the place. 桌子上 has 上 because a desk is a surface.

items.src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī bēi shuǐ
items.task: Say there is no water on the table.
items.zh: 桌子上没有水。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng méi yǒu shuǐ
items.en: There is no water on the table.
items.why: 有 is negated with 没有, and the noun loses its number and measure word.

items.src_py: tā zài bàn gōng shì
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 他不在办公室。
items.py: tā bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: He is not in the office.
items.why: The positive uses 在, so the negative is 不在. 没有 would mean he has no office.

items.src_py: wǒ de bēi zi zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Turn it into a "where is" question.
items.zh: 我的杯子在哪儿？
items.py: wǒ de bēi zi zài nǎ r
items.en: Where is my cup?
items.why: To ask where a known thing is, replace the place with 哪儿 after 在. The cup stays in front.

items.src_py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu dǎ yìn jī
items.task: Turn it into a 有没有 question.
items.zh: 办公室里有没有打印机？
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu méi yǒu dǎ yìn jī
items.en: Is there a printer in the office?
items.why: The A-not-A form of 有 is 有没有, and the place stays at the start.

items.src: 我们医院有一位新医生。
items.src_py: wǒ men yī yuàn yǒu yī wèi xīn yī shēng
items.task: Say a new doctor has joined, using 来.
items.zh: 我们医院来了一位新医生。
items.py: wǒ men yī yuàn lái le yī wèi xīn yī shēng
items.en: A new doctor has joined our hospital.
items.why: An arrival uses 来了 with the newcomer after the verb. The place stays at the start.

items.src_py: qiáng shàng yǒu yī zhāng rì lì
items.task: Say it is hanging on the wall.
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张日历。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng rì lì
items.en: A calendar is hanging on the wall.
items.why: Replace 有 with 挂着 to show how it is placed. The order stays: place, verb, number and measure, noun.

items.src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī fèn wén jiàn
items.task: Say there is not even one document.
items.zh: 桌子上一份文件也没有。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yī fèn wén jiàn yě méi yǒu
items.en: There is not a single document on the table.
items.why: To stress not even one, put 一份文件 in front of 也没有. Plain 没有 takes a bare noun (没有文件); the counted noun before 也没有 is what gives 'not a single one'.

items.src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Say there is a phone on the table (not mine).
items.zh: 桌子上有一部手机。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī bù shǒu jī
items.en: There is a phone on the table.
items.why: An unknown phone is introduced after 有 with the place first. 在 is for the known 我的手机.

items.src_py: gōng sī páng biān yǒu yī jiā yī yuàn
items.task: Use 是 to say what is next to the company.
items.zh: 公司旁边是一家医院。
items.py: gōng sī páng biān shì yī jiā yī yuàn
items.en: Next to the company is a hospital.
items.why: 是 identifies what occupies the spot, replacing 有 in the same frame.

items.src: 办公室门口有一个病人。
items.src_py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu yǒu yī gè bìng rén
items.task: Say the patient is sitting there.
items.zh: 办公室门口坐着一个病人。
items.py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu zuò zhe yī gè bìng rén
items.en: A patient is sitting at the office door.
items.why: 坐着 replaces 有 to show the posture. The patient stays after the verb.

items.src: 昨天办公室来了一位客人。
items.src_py: zuó tiān bàn gōng shì lái le yī wèi kè rén
items.task: Change the time to this morning (今天上午).
items.zh: 今天上午办公室来了一位客人。
items.py: jīn tiān shàng wǔ bàn gōng shì lái le yī wèi kè rén
items.en: A guest came to the office this morning.
items.why: Only the time word changes. The newcomer stays after 来了, and the time and place can swap.

items.src_py: yào zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Say it is in the drawer (抽屉).
items.zh: 药在抽屉里。
items.py: yào zài chōu tì lǐ
items.en: The medicine is in the drawer.
items.why: A drawer is a container, so it needs 里 rather than 上.

items.src: 你要的文件在我的电脑里。
items.src_py: nǐ yào de wén jiàn zài wǒ de diàn nǎo lǐ
items.task: Say it is not there.
items.zh: 你要的文件不在我的电脑里。
items.py: nǐ yào de wén jiàn bù zài wǒ de diàn nǎo lǐ
items.en: The file you want is not on my computer.
items.why: A known file located with 在 is negated with 不在. 没有 does not fit a definite thing.

items.src_py: yào diàn zài yín háng páng biān
items.task: Say it is across from the bank.
items.zh: 药店在银行对面。
items.py: yào diàn zài yín háng duì miàn
items.en: The pharmacy is across from the bank.
items.why: Swap 旁边 for 对面 and keep it after 银行.

items.src_py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén
items.task: Say there are a lot of people.
items.zh: 办公室里有很多人。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén
items.en: There are a lot of people in the office.
items.why: 很多 replaces the number and measure, and the pattern stays Place + 有 + noun.

items.s_py: zhuō zi shàng zài yī tái diàn nǎo
items.zh: 桌子上有一台电脑。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī tái diàn nǎo
items.en: There is a computer on the table.
items.why: 在 cannot be the verb after a bare place with a new thing. With the place first, an indefinite thing is introduced by 有.

items.s_py: xiǎo wáng yǒu huì yì shì lǐ
items.zh: 小王在会议室里。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zài huì yì shì lǐ
items.en: Xiao Wang is in the meeting room.
items.why: Locating a person uses 在. 有 means to have or there is, and cannot link 小王 to a place.

items.s_py: yǎn jìng zài zhuō zi
items.zh: 眼镜在桌子上。
items.py: yǎn jìng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: The glasses are on the table.
items.why: 桌子 is an object and needs 上 to become a place after 在.

items.s_py: wǒ gē ge zài shàng hǎi lǐ gōng zuò
items.zh: 我哥哥在上海工作。
items.py: wǒ gē ge zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
items.en: My older brother works in Shanghai.
items.why: City names are already places, so 里 must not be added after them.

items.s_py: yín háng zài páng biān gōng sī
items.zh: 银行在公司旁边。
items.py: yín háng zài gōng sī páng biān
items.en: The bank is next to the company.
items.why: The location word comes after the reference noun: 公司旁边. The English order is wrong.

items.s_py: chōu tì lǐ bù yǒu yào
items.zh: 抽屉里没有药。
items.py: chōu tì lǐ méi yǒu yào
items.en: There is no medicine in the drawer.
items.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没, so 不有 never exists.

items.s_py: yī gè yī shēng zhàn zhe zài mén kǒu
items.zh: 门口站着一个医生。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè yī shēng
items.en: A doctor is standing at the door.
items.why: A new person is introduced after the verb, with the place first. 站着 is not followed by 在 and a place.

items.s: 昨天医院来着两位新医生。
items.s_py: zuó tiān yī yuàn lái zhe liǎng wèi xīn yī shēng
items.zh: 昨天医院来了两位新医生。
items.py: zuó tiān yī yuàn lái le liǎng wèi xīn yī shēng
items.en: Two new doctors came to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: An arrival is a completed event, so 来 takes 了. 着 describes a continuing state and cannot go after 来 here.

items.s: 我的朋友现在在中国里。
items.s_py: wǒ de péng you xiàn zài zài zhōng guó lǐ
items.zh: 我的朋友现在在中国。
items.py: wǒ de péng you xiàn zài zài zhōng guó
items.en: My friend is in China now.
items.why: Country names are already places. 里 must not follow 中国.

items.s_py: jīng lǐ zuò zài hòu miàn wǒ men
items.zh: 经理坐在我们后面。
items.py: jīng lǐ zuò zài wǒ men hòu miàn
items.en: The manager sits behind us.
items.why: The location word follows the noun: 我们后面. Putting it first is the English order.

items.s_py: xué xiào duì miàn zài yī jiā yào diàn
items.zh: 学校对面是一家药店。
items.py: xué xiào duì miàn shì yī jiā yào diàn
items.en: Across from the school is a pharmacy.
items.why: With the place at the start, the verb is 是 (or 有), never 在. 在 needs the thing before it.

items.s: 我家附近有一家很大的医院。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de yī yuàn
items.zh: 我家附近有一家很大的医院。
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de yī yuàn
items.en: There is a very big hospital near my home.
items.why: Place first, 有, then an indefinite thing. The long description of the hospital does not change the pattern.

items.s_py: yī yuàn duì miàn shì wǒ men gōng sī
items.zh: 医院对面是我们公司。
items.py: yī yuàn duì miàn shì wǒ men gōng sī
items.en: Across from the hospital is our company.
items.why: A definite occupant (我们公司) after a place takes 是. 有 would be wrong here, and 在 does not follow the place.

items.s_py: wǒ mā ma zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.zh: 我妈妈在医院工作。
items.py: wǒ mā ma zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: My mother works at the hospital.
items.why: 医院 is an institution that already counts as a place, so 里 or 上 is not needed after 在.

items.s: 他在飞机上看了一份文件。
items.s_py: tā zài fēi jī shàng kàn le yī fèn wén jiàn
items.zh: 他在飞机上看了一份文件。
items.py: tā zài fēi jī shàng kàn le yī fèn wén jiàn
items.en: He read a document on the plane.
items.why: Chinese uses 上 for vehicles where English says on or in. 在飞机上 is the standard form.

items.s_py: jīng lǐ zuó tiān bù zài gōng sī
items.zh: 经理昨天不在公司。
items.py: jīng lǐ zuó tiān bù zài gōng sī
items.en: The manager was not at the company yesterday.
items.why: 不在 also works for a past day. A known person not at a place is always 不在, never 不有.

items.s_py: yào xiāng lǐ yī piàn yào yě méi yǒu
items.zh: 药箱里一片药也没有。
items.py: yào xiāng lǐ yī piàn yào yě méi yǒu
items.en: There is not a single pill in the medicine box.
items.why: 一 + measure + noun + 也没有 is the emphatic not even one. The number and measure only come before 也没有.

items.s_py: bìng chuáng shàng tǎng zhe yī wèi lǎo rén
items.zh: 病床上躺着一位老人。
items.py: bìng chuáng shàng tǎng zhe yī wèi lǎo rén
items.en: An old man is lying on the hospital bed.
items.why: Place + 躺着 + number + measure + noun is the standard way to describe who lies there. The old man follows the verb.

items.s: 经理等的客人已经来了。
items.s_py: jīng lǐ děng de kè rén yǐ jīng lái le
items.zh: 经理等的客人已经来了。
items.py: jīng lǐ děng de kè rén yǐ jīng lái le
items.en: The guest the manager was waiting for has arrived.
items.why: A definite, expected guest goes before the verb as the subject. Only a new, unexpected arrival goes after 来了.

items.s: 前面有一家药店，我去买点药。
items.s_py: qián miàn yǒu yī jiā yào diàn, wǒ qù mǎi diǎn yào
items.zh: 前面有一家药店，我去买点药。
items.py: qián miàn yǒu yī jiā yào diàn, wǒ qù mǎi diǎn yào
items.en: There is a pharmacy ahead, I will go and buy some medicine.
items.why: A location word can stand alone as the place. 前面 opens the sentence and 有 introduces the new pharmacy.

items.q: 商店里___很多人。
items.zh: 商店里有很多人。
items.py: shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén
items.en: There are a lot of people in the shop.
items.why: The place opens the sentence and 很多人 is a new, unspecified group, so 有 is the verb. 在 needs the thing first and the place after it, and 没有 would say there are no people, contradicting the meaning.

items.q: 超市门口___三辆自行车。
items.zh: 超市门口有三辆自行车。
items.py: chāo shì mén kǒu yǒu sān liàng zì xíng chē
items.en: There are three bicycles at the supermarket entrance.
items.why: Place first plus a counted new thing (三辆自行车) means 有. 在 cannot follow a place and then introduce a counted noun.

items.q: 公园附近___体育馆，只有一个很小的游泳池。
items.zh: 公园附近没有体育馆，只有一个很小的游泳池。
items.py: gōng yuán fù jìn méi yǒu tǐ yù guǎn zhǐ yǒu yī gè hěn xiǎo de yóu yǒng chí
items.en: There is no gym near the park, only a very small swimming pool.
items.why: Saying a thing does not exist in a place is 没有 plus a bare noun. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 needs the thing first (体育馆不在公园附近).

items.q: 那家新开的鞋店里___各种各样的运动鞋，价格也不贵。
items.zh: 那家新开的鞋店里有各种各样的运动鞋，价格也不贵。
items.py: nà jiā xīn kāi de xié diàn lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de yùn dòng xié jià gé yě bù guì
items.en: The newly opened shoe shop has all kinds of sports shoes, and the prices are not high either.
items.why: Place first, then a new and indefinite set of things (各种各样的运动鞋): 有. 在 would need the shoes in front and a location after it.

items.q: 我家附近的体育馆里___一个游泳池和两个羽毛球场。
items.zh: 我家附近的体育馆里有一个游泳池和两个羽毛球场。
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn de tǐ yù guǎn lǐ yǒu yī gè yóu yǒng chí hé liǎng gè yǔ máo qiú chǎng
items.en: The gym near my home has a swimming pool and two badminton courts.
items.why: The sentence lists what a place contains, starting from the place, so it takes 有. 在 would make the pool and courts the topic and point to a place after the verb.

items.q: 我的球鞋___门后面。
items.zh: 我的球鞋在门后面。
items.py: wǒ de qiú xié zài mén hòu miàn
items.en: My sports shoes are behind the door.
items.why: 我的球鞋 is a known thing placed first, so its location is stated with 在. 有 would need the place at the start, and 是 would not say where it is.

items.q: 收银台___商店的左边。
items.zh: 收银台在商店的左边。
items.py: shōu yín tái zài shāng diàn de zuǒ biān
items.en: The checkout counter is on the left side of the shop.
items.why: The counter is a known thing placed first, and its position is the news, so 在. 有 and 是 cannot sit between a known thing and a place.

items.q: 你要买的那双鞋___三楼。
items.zh: 你要买的那双鞋在三楼。
items.py: nǐ yào mǎi de nà shuāng xié zài sān lóu
items.en: The pair of shoes you want to buy is on the third floor.
items.why: 你要买的那双鞋 is a specific known pair, so it comes first and 在 gives its location. 有 would introduce a new thing and needs the place in front.

items.q: 小王的羽毛球拍___哪儿？
items.zh: 小王的羽毛球拍在哪儿？
items.py: xiǎo wáng de yǔ máo qiú pāi zài nǎ r
items.en: Where is Xiao Wang's badminton racket?
items.why: Asking the location of a known thing is 在哪儿. 有哪儿 and 是哪儿 do not ask where something is.

items.q: 我昨天看中的那件运动服___二楼的女装区旁边。
items.zh: 我昨天看中的那件运动服在二楼的女装区旁边。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn zhòng de nà jiàn yùn dòng fú zài èr lóu de nǚ zhuāng qū páng biān
items.en: The sports jacket I liked yesterday is next to the women's clothing section on the second floor.
items.why: The jacket is already known (我昨天看中的那件), so it goes first and is located with 在. Putting 有 after a known thing is ungrammatical.

items.q: 篮球场对面___李老师的家。
items.zh: 篮球场对面是李老师的家。
items.py: lán qiú chǎng duì miàn shì lǐ lǎo shī de jiā
items.en: Across from the basketball court is Teacher Li's home.
items.why: The place comes first and the named occupant follows, so 是 identifies what is there. 在 needs the thing before it, not the place.

items.q: 我家后面___一个很大的体育馆。
items.zh: 我家后面是一个很大的体育馆。
items.py: wǒ jiā hòu miàn shì yī gè hěn dà de tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Behind my home is a very big gym.
items.why: Place first, then naming what is there: 是. 在 would only work with the thing in front (体育馆在我家后面).

items.q: 这条街的左边全___卖运动用品的商店，右边都是饭馆。
items.zh: 这条街的左边全是卖运动用品的商店，右边都是饭馆。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē de zuǒ biān quán shì mài yùn dòng yòng pǐn de shāng diàn yòu biān dōu shì fàn guǎn
items.en: The left side of this street is all shops selling sports goods, and the right side is all restaurants.
items.why: 全是 and 都是 say a place is filled with one kind of thing, and the parallel clause uses 是 too. 全在 is not a pattern with a place in front.

items.q: 手机在桌子___。
items.zh: 手机在桌子上。
items.py: shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: The phone is on the table.
items.why: A table is an object and needs a location word; the phone rests on its surface, so 上. 里 would put it inside the table, and nothing at all leaves 桌子 as a plain object.

items.q: 钱在包___。
items.zh: 钱在包里。
items.py: qián zài bāo lǐ
items.en: The money is in the bag.
items.why: 包 is an object, so it needs a location word, and the money is inside, so 里. 上 would mean on the outside surface.

items.q: 饮料在冰箱___。
items.zh: 饮料在冰箱里。
items.py: yǐn liào zài bīng xiāng lǐ
items.en: The drinks are in the fridge.
items.why: 冰箱 is an object, not a place by itself, so after 在 it needs 里. Leaving it bare is the classic mistake (在冰箱).

items.q: 他在上海___买了一件运动服。
items.zh: 他在上海买了一件运动服。
items.py: tā zài shàng hǎi mǎi le yī jiàn yùn dòng fú
items.en: He bought a sports jacket in Shanghai.
items.why: 上海 is a city name and already a place, so nothing is added after it. 里 and 上 are never put after a city.

items.q: 我哥哥在北京___学打网球。
items.zh: 我哥哥在北京学打网球。
items.py: wǒ gē gē zài běi jīng xué dǎ wǎng qiú
items.en: My older brother is learning to play tennis in Beijing.
items.why: City names are places already, so no 里 after 北京. English "in" is fully covered by 在.

items.q: 价格写在这张小纸___。
items.zh: 价格写在这张小纸上。
items.py: jià gé xiě zài zhè zhāng xiǎo zhǐ shàng
items.en: The price is written on this small piece of paper.
items.why: Writing sits on a flat surface, so 上 goes after 纸. 里 would put it inside the paper, and 外 would put it outside the paper.

items.q: 球票放在我的书包___。
items.zh: 球票放在我的书包里。
items.py: qiú piào fàng zài wǒ de shū bāo lǐ
items.en: The match ticket is in my school bag.
items.why: A bag holds things inside, so 里 after 书包. 上 would put the ticket on the outside of the bag, and 外 would be outside it.

items.q: 教练把比赛名单写在黑板___。
items.zh: 教练把比赛名单写在黑板上。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ bǐ sài míng dān xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng
items.en: The coach wrote the match list on the blackboard.
items.why: Chinese uses 上 for things written on a board; 黑板里 would mean inside it and bare 黑板 is not a place.

items.q: 我把新买的球拍挂在墙___，这样孩子拿不到。
items.zh: 我把新买的球拍挂在墙上，这样孩子拿不到。
items.py: wǒ bǎ xīn mǎi de qiú pāi guà zài qiáng shàng zhè yàng hái zi ná bù dào
items.en: I hung the newly bought racket on the wall so the children cannot reach it.
items.why: Something hung on a wall is on its surface, so 墙上. 墙里 would put it inside the wall, and 墙旁 is not a word.

items.q: 我小时候在广州___学会了游泳，后来才搬到上海。
items.zh: 我小时候在广州学会了游泳，后来才搬到上海。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zài guǎng zhōu xué huì le yóu yǒng hòu lái cái bān dào shàng hǎi
items.en: I learned to swim in Guangzhou as a child and only later moved to Shanghai.
items.why: 广州 is a city and already a place, so it takes no 里, even in a longer sentence.

items.q: 咖啡店在体育馆___。
items.zh: 咖啡店在体育馆旁边。
items.py: kā fēi diàn zài tǐ yù guǎn páng biān
items.en: The coffee shop is next to the gym.
items.why: The cue says "next to", which is 旁边. 对面 means across from and 中间 means between, which needs two reference points.

items.q: 我的自行车停在商店___，不在里面。
items.zh: 我的自行车停在商店外面，不在里面。
items.py: wǒ de zì xíng chē tíng zài shāng diàn wài miàn bù zài lǐ miàn
items.en: My bike is parked outside the shop, not inside it.
items.why: The second clause says it is not inside, so the word is 外面. 里面 contradicts it and 中间 needs two things to be between.

items.q: 这家鞋店在银行和超市___。
items.zh: 这家鞋店在银行和超市中间。
items.py: zhè jiā xié diàn zài yín háng hé chāo shì zhōng jiān
items.en: This shoe shop is between the bank and the supermarket.
items.why: Two reference nouns joined by 和 take 中间. 对面 and 附近 work with one reference point.

items.q: 游泳池在公园___，走路五分钟就到。
items.zh: 游泳池在公园附近，走路五分钟就到。
items.py: yóu yǒng chí zài gōng yuán fù jìn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
items.en: The swimming pool is near the park, five minutes on foot.
items.why: A five-minute walk means near, not adjacent, so 附近. 旁边 means right beside it, and 后面 gives a direction the sentence never mentions.

items.q: 教练站在我们___。
items.zh: 教练站在我们前面。
items.py: jiào liàn zhàn zài wǒ men qián miàn
items.en: The coach is standing in front of us.
items.why: The cue says in front of us: 前面 follows the reference word 我们. 后面 is the opposite direction.

items.q: 超市___有一家很大的运动用品店。
items.zh: 超市对面有一家很大的运动用品店。
items.py: chāo shì duì miàn yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn
items.en: Across from the supermarket there is a big sports goods shop.
items.why: Reference noun plus location word gives 超市对面. 面对 and 对着 are verbs, not location words, so they cannot form the place at the start.

items.q: 球场门口一直站___几个小朋友。
items.zh: 球场门口一直站着几个小朋友。
items.py: qiú chǎng mén kǒu yī zhí zhàn zhe jǐ gè xiǎo péng yǒu
items.en: A few children have been standing at the entrance of the pitch all along.
items.why: 一直 shows a continuing state, so 站着. 了 marks a completed change, and 过 marks a past experience, neither of which goes with 一直.

items.q: 我们教室的墙上挂___一张很大的球赛海报。
items.zh: 我们教室的墙上挂着一张很大的球赛海报。
items.py: wǒ men jiào shì de qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng hěn dà de qiú sài hǎi bào
items.en: On the wall of our classroom hangs a big match poster.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + new thing is the pattern for a state. 挂在 would need the thing in front and the place after it, and 过 reports a past experience.

items.q: 货架上摆___很多新到的球鞋。
items.zh: 货架上摆着很多新到的球鞋。
items.py: huò jià shàng bǎi zhe hěn duō xīn dào de qiú xié
items.en: Many newly arrived sports shoes are displayed on the shelves.
items.why: Place first, a verb with 着, then the new thing. 摆在 would put the place after the verb with the things in front.

items.q: 柜台上放___三瓶饮料。
items.zh: 柜台上放着三瓶饮料。
items.py: guì tái shàng fàng zhe sān píng yǐn liào
items.en: There are three bottles of drink on the counter.
items.why: Place + 放着 + counted thing describes what is lying there. 在 cannot attach to a verb in front of a counted noun in this order.

items.q: 昨天我们队来___一个新教练。
items.zh: 昨天我们队来了一个新教练。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ men duì lái le yī gè xīn jiào liàn
items.en: A new coach joined our team yesterday.
items.why: A newcomer after the verb needs 了, as this happened yesterday. 着 would describe a continuing state, and 的 cannot mark a completed event.

items.q: 我们学校旁边上个月新开___一个游泳馆。
items.zh: 我们学校旁边上个月新开了一个游泳馆。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào páng biān shàng gè yuè xīn kāi le yī gè yóu yǒng guǎn
items.en: A new swimming pool opened next to our school last month.
items.why: A shop or pool newly appearing is a completed event, so 开了 with the new thing after the verb. 着 describes a continuing state and 过 an experience; neither fits 上个月新开 here.

items.q: 我们公司走___三个人，现在只剩五个人。
items.zh: 我们公司走了三个人，现在只剩五个人。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī zǒu le sān gè rén xiàn zài zhǐ shèng wǔ gè rén
items.en: Three people have left our company; now only five remain.
items.why: Three people departing is a completed change, so 走了 with the leavers after the verb. 着 would be a continuing state and 过 would be a past experience.

items.q: 商店门口突然出现___一大群人，大家都在等打折。
items.zh: 商店门口突然出现了一大群人，大家都在等打折。
items.py: shāng diàn mén kǒu tū rán chū xiàn le yī dà qún rén dà jiā dōu zài děng dǎ zhé
items.en: A big crowd suddenly appeared at the shop entrance; everyone was waiting for the sale.
items.why: 突然 marks a sudden event, completed: 出现了 plus the new crowd after the verb. 着 does not go with 突然, and 过 is not about a sudden single event.

items.q: 冰箱里___饮料了。
items.zh: 冰箱里没有饮料了。
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu yǐn liào le
items.en: There are no more drinks in the fridge.
items.why: Non-existence is 没有 plus a bare noun. 不有 does not exist, and 不在 needs the drink in front as a known thing.

items.q: 老板今天___店里。
items.zh: 老板今天不在店里。
items.py: lǎo bǎn jīn tiān bù zài diàn lǐ
items.en: The boss is not in the shop today.
items.why: A known person not being at a place is 不在 with the place after it. 没有 would negate possession or existence, not location.

items.q: 我的球拍___桌子上，你再找找。
items.zh: 我的球拍不在桌子上，你再找找。
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi bù zài zhuō zi shàng nǐ zài zhǎo zhǎo
items.en: My racket is not on the table; look again.
items.why: A known thing not at a place is 不在. 没有 cannot directly negate a place phrase after a known thing, and 不是 would deny an identity.

items.zh: 超市旁边有一家体育用品店。
items.py: chāo shì páng biān yǒu yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
items.en: There is a sports shop next to the supermarket.
items.why: Place first, then 有, then the new counted thing. The shop is indefinite, so it cannot open the sentence with 在.

items.zh: 房间里有两个足球。
items.py: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu liǎng gè zú qiú
items.en: There are two footballs in the room.
items.why: Existence starts with the place (房间里) and ends with the new counted thing. The number and noun come after 有, never before the place.

items.zh: 商场里有很多买运动鞋的人。
items.py: shāng chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō mǎi yùn dòng xié de rén
items.en: There are many people buying sports shoes in the mall.
items.why: New people announced in a place: place + 有 + 很多 + noun phrase. The long noun phrase stays after 有.

items.zh: 我的球鞋在床下面。
items.py: wǒ de qiú xié zài chuáng xià miàn
items.en: My sports shoes are under the bed.
items.why: A known thing (我的球鞋) goes first and 在 places it; the place cannot start the sentence with 在 after it.

items.zh: 你的运动包在沙发后面。
items.py: nǐ de yùn dòng bāo zài shā fā hòu miàn
items.en: Your sports bag is behind the sofa.
items.why: 你的运动包 is definite, so it comes first and 在 gives its place. The location word 后面 follows 沙发.

items.zh: 小王在游泳池旁边。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zài yóu yǒng chí páng biān
items.en: Xiao Wang is next to the swimming pool.
items.why: A named person goes first, then 在, then the reference noun, and 旁边 after the reference noun, not before it.

items.zh: 银行在超市和书店中间。
items.py: yín háng zài chāo shì hé shū diàn zhōng jiān
items.en: The bank is between the supermarket and the bookshop.
items.why: 中间 follows both reference nouns, as in 超市和书店中间. English puts "between" first; Chinese puts it last.

items.zh: 体育馆对面是一家咖啡店。
items.py: tǐ yù guǎn duì miàn shì yī jiā kā fēi diàn
items.en: Across from the gym is a coffee shop.
items.why: Place first, 是 introduces what occupies it. 在 cannot follow a place, and the reference noun stays before 对面.

items.zh: 我家后面是我常去打球的那个公园。
items.py: wǒ jiā hòu miàn shì wǒ cháng qù dǎ qiú de nà ge gōng yuán
items.en: Behind my home is the park where I often play ball.
items.why: The occupant is definite (那个公园), so 是 is the verb after the place. 有 would be unnatural with a known park.

items.zh: 门口站着一个卖球票的人。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè mài qiú piào de rén
items.en: Someone selling match tickets is standing at the entrance.
items.why: Place first, 站着, then the new person. The person cannot come before 站着, and 着 is not followed by a place.

items.zh: 橱窗里挂着一件红色运动服。
items.py: chú chuāng lǐ guà zhe yī jiàn hóng sè yùn dòng fú
items.en: A red sports jacket hangs in the shop window.
items.why: Place + verb with 着 + counted new thing. 挂着 stays in front of the thing because the order is state first, thing last.

items.zh: 桌子上放着两瓶水。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng píng shuǐ
items.en: There are two bottles of water on the table.
items.why: Place at the start, 放着 next, then number-measure-noun last.

items.zh: 商场里来了很多买东西的人。
items.py: shāng chǎng lǐ lái le hěn duō mǎi dōng xī de rén
items.en: A lot of shoppers have arrived in the mall.
items.why: Place first, then 来了, and the newcomers last. Putting the people before the verb would make them a known group.

items.zh: 昨天商店里来了一位老客人。
items.py: zuó tiān shāng diàn lǐ lái le yī wèi lǎo kè rén
items.en: An old customer came to the shop yesterday.
items.why: The time word and place both open the sentence, in either order, and 一位老客人 follows 来了.

items.zh: 上个月对面新开了一家体育用品店。
items.py: shàng gè yuè duì miàn xīn kāi le yī jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn
items.en: A new sports goods shop opened across the street last month.
items.why: The time and place go before the verb, in either order, and the new shop comes last after 新开了.

items.zh: 商店里没有人。
items.py: shāng diàn lǐ méi yǒu rén
items.en: There is nobody in the shop.
items.why: Place + 没有 + bare noun. No number or measure word follows 没有 in the plain negative.

items.zh: 我的球拍不在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi bù zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: My racket is not on the table.
items.why: A known thing not at a place is 不在, with the thing first and the place last.

items.zh: 书店里没有运动杂志。
items.py: shū diàn lǐ méi yǒu yùn dòng zá zhì
items.en: There are no sports magazines in the bookshop.
items.why: Non-existence is 没有 with the place first and a bare noun last.

items.zh: 经理今天不在办公室。
items.py: jīng lǐ jīn tiān bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: The manager is not in the office today.
items.why: The known person comes first or after 今天, then 不在 and the place. 不在 negates location; 没有 would negate existence.

items.zh: 球场旁边有一家小卖部。
items.py: qiú chǎng páng biān yǒu yī jiā xiǎo mài bù
items.en: There is a small shop next to the pitch.
items.why: Reference noun + 旁边 forms the place, then 有 and the new counted thing.

items.zh: 你昨天买的那双球鞋在衣柜最下面。
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān mǎi de nà shuāng qiú xié zài yī guì zuì xià miàn
items.en: The pair of sports shoes you bought yesterday is at the very bottom of the wardrobe.
items.why: The long definite phrase 你昨天买的那双球鞋 goes first, then 在 and the place. 有 cannot take a known thing.

items.zh: 球迷站在教练后面。
items.py: qiú mí zhàn zài jiào liàn hòu miàn
items.en: The fans are standing behind the coach.
items.why: The location word follows its reference: 教练后面, not 后面教练. 站在 comes directly before the reference.

items.zh: 他在北京打网球。
items.py: tā zài běi jīng dǎ wǎng qiú
items.en: He plays tennis in Beijing.
items.why: 北京 is a city and takes no 里. Placing 在北京 before the verb gives where the playing happens.

items.zh: 牛奶在冰箱里。
items.py: niú nǎi zài bīng xiāng lǐ
items.en: The milk is in the fridge.
items.why: 冰箱 is an object and needs 里 after it. 上 would put the milk outside the fridge.

items.zh: 我们学校后面有一个可以踢足球的小操场。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào hòu miàn yǒu yī gè kě yǐ tī zú qiú de xiǎo cāo chǎng
items.en: Behind our school there is a small field where one can play football.
items.why: Place first, 有, then a new counted thing with a long modifier. The modifier must stay inside the noun phrase after 有.

items.src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè lán qiú
items.task: Say there is no basketball (没有).
items.zh: 桌子上没有篮球。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng méi yǒu lán qiú
items.en: There is no basketball on the table.
items.why: 没有 negates 有, and the number-measure 一个 is dropped in the plain negative.

items.src_py: wǒ de shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Say it is not there.
items.zh: 我的手机不在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: My phone is not on the table.
items.why: The positive uses 在, so the negative is 不在. 没有 would negate existence, not location.

items.src_py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yóu yǒng chí
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 公园里没有游泳池。
items.py: gōng yuán lǐ méi yǒu yóu yǒng chí
items.en: There is no swimming pool in the park.
items.why: Existence with 有 becomes 没有. 不有 does not exist.

items.src: 球场旁边有一家咖啡店。
items.src_py: qiú chǎng páng biān yǒu yī jiā kā fēi diàn
items.task: Start with 那家咖啡店 (the known café) and say where it is.
items.zh: 那家咖啡店在球场旁边。
items.py: nà jiā kā fēi diàn zài qiú chǎng páng biān
items.en: That café is next to the pitch.
items.why: With a known café placed first, the verb must be 在, and the location follows it. 有 would introduce something new.

items.src: 墙上有一张篮球赛海报。
items.src_py: qiáng shàng yǒu yī zhāng lán qiú sài hǎi bào
items.task: Use 挂着 instead of 有.
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张篮球赛海报。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng lán qiú sài hǎi bào
items.en: On the wall hangs a basketball match poster.
items.why: The verb is replaced by 挂着 while the place stays first and the new thing last.

items.src_py: yī wèi xīn jiào liàn lái le qiú duì
items.task: Fix the word order: the new person comes after the verb.
items.zh: 球队来了一位新教练。
items.py: qiú duì lái le yī wèi xīn jiào liàn
items.en: A new coach has joined the team.
items.why: The place opens the sentence and the newcomer follows 来了. Trailing the place after 来了 is the English order.

items.src_py: chāo shì páng biān yǒu yī jiā yín háng
items.task: Say the thing next to the supermarket is that bank (是, 那家银行).
items.zh: 超市旁边是那家银行。
items.py: chāo shì páng biān shì nà jiā yín háng
items.en: Next to the supermarket is that bank.
items.why: A definite thing after a place needs 是 to identify it. 有 introduces new things.

items.src_py: nǐ de qián bāo zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Turn it into a question with 哪儿.
items.zh: 你的钱包在哪儿？
items.py: nǐ de qián bāo zài nǎ r
items.en: Where is your wallet?
items.why: The question word replaces the place after 在, and the known wallet stays first.

items.src_py: zhè r fù jìn yǒu yín háng
items.task: Turn it into a 有没有 question.
items.zh: 这儿附近有没有银行？
items.py: zhè r fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu yín háng
items.en: Is there a bank near here?
items.why: The A-not-A form of 有 is 有没有, placed after the place with the noun after it.

items.src_py: shǒu jī zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Replace 桌子上 with 抽屉 (inside the drawer).
items.zh: 手机在抽屉里。
items.py: shǒu jī zài chōu tì lǐ
items.en: The phone is in the drawer.
items.why: A drawer is a container, so it needs 里 after it. 上 would be on the drawer.

items.src_py: yín háng zài xué xiào páng biān
items.task: Say the bank is across from the school (对面).
items.zh: 银行在学校对面。
items.py: yín háng zài xué xiào duì miàn
items.en: The bank is across from the school.
items.why: The location word goes after the reference noun: 学校对面.

items.src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng bēi kā fēi
items.task: Use 放着 instead of 有.
items.zh: 桌子上放着两杯咖啡。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe liǎng bēi kā fēi
items.en: Two cups of coffee are on the table.
items.why: The same place-first pattern with 放着 describing how the cups are sitting.

items.src: 我们学校附近有一个很大的运动场。
items.src_py: wǒ men xué xiào fù jìn yǒu yī gè hěn dà de yùn dòng chǎng
items.task: Say there is no sports ground (没有).
items.zh: 我们学校附近没有运动场。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào fù jìn méi yǒu yùn dòng chǎng
items.en: There is no sports ground near our school.
items.why: Existence is negated with 没有, and the number-measure and modifier are dropped.

items.src_py: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu hěn duō qiú
items.task: Say the room is full of balls (都是).
items.zh: 房间里都是球。
items.py: fáng jiān lǐ dōu shì qiú
items.en: The room is full of balls.
items.why: 都是 after a place says it is filled with one kind of thing. 有 would only say there are many.

items.src_py: yī gè qián bāo zài zhuō zi shàng
items.task: Fix it: a new thing, so the place goes first.
items.zh: 桌子上有一个钱包。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī gè qián bāo
items.en: There is a wallet on the table.
items.why: A new counted thing cannot start the sentence with 在. Place first, 有, then the thing.

items.s_py: yī gè shǒu jī zài guì tái shàng

items.py: guì tái shàng yǒu yī gè shǒu jī
items.en: There is a phone on the counter.
items.why: An indefinite thing cannot be the subject of 在. Start with the place and use 有.

items.s: 你要的那双球鞋在三楼。

items.py: nǐ yào de nà shuāng qiú xié zài sān lóu
items.en: The pair of sports shoes you want is on the third floor.
items.why: A known pair goes first and 在 locates it. 有 would be wrong here.

items.s_py: nǐ de shǒu jī yǒu guì tái shàng
items.zh: 你的手机在柜台上。
items.py: nǐ de shǒu jī zài guì tái shàng
items.en: Your phone is on the counter.
items.why: Locating a known thing needs 在 between the thing and its place. 有 cannot link 你的手机 to 柜台上.

items.s: 学校对面是一家体育用品店。

items.s: 银行对面在一家体育用品店。

items.why: 在 cannot follow a place. Use 是 (or 有) after it.

items.s_py: wǒ de qiú pāi zài zhuō zi
items.zh: 我的球拍在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: My racket is on the table.
items.why: 桌子 is an object, so it needs 上 after 在.

items.s_py: wǒ jiě jiě zài shàng hǎi lǐ gōng zuò
items.zh: 我姐姐在上海工作。
items.py: wǒ jiě jiě zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
items.en: My older sister works in Shanghai.
items.why: City names never take 里. 在 alone covers "in".

items.s: 他们在地铁上看足球比赛。

items.en: They watch the football match on the subway.
items.why: 地铁上 is correct: Chinese uses 上 for vehicles.

items.s_py: chāo shì zài páng biān yín háng

items.py: chāo shì zài yín háng páng biān

items.py: yín háng de páng biān yǒu yī jiā shū diàn
items.en: There is a bookshop next to the bank.
items.why: 的 may be put before a two-syllable location word like 旁边, so this is correct.

items.s_py: zhuō zi de shàng yǒu yī běn zá zhì

items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī běn zá zhì
items.en: There is a magazine on the table.
items.why: 上 attaches directly with no 的.

items.s: 门口站着很多买票的人。
items.s_py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe hěn duō mǎi piào de rén
items.zh: 门口站着很多买票的人。
items.py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe hěn duō mǎi piào de rén
items.en: Many people buying tickets are standing at the door.
items.why: Place + verb + 着 + new group is correct.

items.s_py: yī zhāng hǎi bào guà zhe zài qiáng shàng
items.zh: 墙上挂着一张海报。
items.py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng hǎi bào
items.en: A poster hangs on the wall.
items.why: The new thing goes last, with the place first.

items.s: 今天店里来了很多客人。
items.s_py: jīn tiān diàn lǐ lái le hěn duō kè rén
items.zh: 今天店里来了很多客人。
items.py: jīn tiān diàn lǐ lái le hěn duō kè rén
items.en: Many customers came to the shop today.
items.why: Time and place open the sentence, and the newcomers follow 来了.

items.s: 一个新店员来了我们商店。
items.s_py: yī gè xīn diàn yuán lái le wǒ men shāng diàn
items.zh: 我们商店来了一个新店员。
items.py: wǒ men shāng diàn lái le yī gè xīn diàn yuán
items.en: A new clerk has joined our shop.
items.why: The place cannot trail after 来了. It opens the sentence and the newcomer follows.

items.s_py: bīng xiāng lǐ bù yǒu niú nǎi
items.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶。
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu niú nǎi
items.en: There is no milk in the fridge.
items.why: 有 is only negated with 没.

items.s: 小王今天不在体育馆，在游泳池。

items.zh: 小王今天不在体育馆，在游泳池。
items.py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān bù zài tǐ yù guǎn zài yóu yǒng chí
items.en: Xiao Wang is not at the gym today; he is at the pool.
items.why: 不在 negates 在, and the second clause contrasts with 在.

items.s_py: diàn zhǎng jīn tiān méi yǒu shāng diàn lǐ
items.zh: 店长今天不在商店里。
items.py: diàn zhǎng jīn tiān bù zài shāng diàn lǐ
items.en: The shop manager is not in the shop today.

items.s: 我们小区门口有一家很大的体育用品店，对面是超市。
items.s_py: wǒ men xiǎo qū mén kǒu yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn duì miàn shì chāo shì
items.zh: 我们小区门口有一家很大的体育用品店，对面是超市。
items.py: wǒ men xiǎo qū mén kǒu yǒu yī jiā hěn dà de tǐ yù yòng pǐn diàn duì miàn shì chāo shì
items.en: There is a big sports goods shop at the entrance of our compound, and across from it is a supermarket.
items.why: 有 introduces the shop and 是 names what is across from it.

items.s: 你的羽毛球拍是桌子上。
items.s_py: nǐ de yǔ máo qiú pāi shì zhuō zi shàng
items.zh: 你的羽毛球拍在桌子上。
items.py: nǐ de yǔ máo qiú pāi zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Your badminton racket is on the table.
